definitions.gloss: word coinage; the act of creating new words
definitions.explanation: word coinage; the act of creating new words

examples.japanese: 「リモハラ」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リモート→リモート：04743_rimooto⟧⟦ハラスメント→ハラスメント：11288_harasumento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{造語|ぞうご}だ。
examples.english: 'Rimohara' is a coined word for remote harassment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{造語|ぞうご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧SNS⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生|う}まれている→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: New coined words are being born one after another from social media.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{西洋|せいよう}→西洋：01446_seiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢語|かんご}→漢語：13439_kango⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{造語|ぞうご}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the Meiji era, many Sino-Japanese words were coined to express Western concepts.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{造語|ぞうご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多用|たよう}→多用：12300_tayou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That author frequently uses self-coined words in their works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{造語|ぞうご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In scientific fields, coining new words becomes necessary with each new discovery.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{造語|ぞうご}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{載|の}っていない→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: This word is a neologism, so it is not in the dictionary.

notes:
Can refer both to the resulting new word and to the process of creating it. Japanese is highly productive in word coinage, particularly through combining kanji compounds, abbreviation of katakana words, and blending. Many words that are now standard Japanese were originally {造語|ぞうご} from the Meiji era.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {造語|ぞうご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: create a coined word
- {造語|ぞうご}{力|りょく}: word-coining ability/productivity
- {和製|わせい}{造語|ぞうご}: Japanese-made coined word

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{新語|しんご}→新語：21555_shingo⟧: new word — any word recently entering use, not necessarily coined
- ⟦{略語|りゃくご}→略語：21705_ryakugo⟧: abbreviation — a shortened form of an existing word
- ⟦{和製英語|わせいえいご}→和製英語：18947_waseieigo⟧: Japanese-made English — English-sounding words coined in Japanese
